allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: for subscription to the Rights Issue of Allcargo Group Services Private Limited ("AGSPL"), Associate Company.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Allcargo Terminals Limited has informed the Exchange about amendment in Vesting Schedule of ATL CEO Employee Stock Option Plan, 2025

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Allcargo Terminals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Allotment of Partly paid shares'.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Allcargo Terminals Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 10, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 3 : 19, i.e 3 Equity Shares for every 19 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 20 per share.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: The Board of Directors of the Company have approved Rights issue of equity shares amounting to Rupees 80,00,00,000 (Rupees Eighty Crores only)

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Allcargo Terminals Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on October 07, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis amounting to Rupees 80,00,00,000 (Rupees Eighty Crores only)

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Allcargo Terminals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation of  new ISIN for Warrants'.

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Allcargo Terminals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 13200000 securities pursuant to Preferential Issue at its meeting held on September 05, 2025

allot.subject: Options to purchase securities
allot.text: Allcargo Terminals Limited has informed the Exchange about the Employee Stock Option Plan.

allot.subject: Preferential issue
allot.text: Allcargo Terminals Limited has informed the Exchange about Preferential issue
